2025-09-cedarline-debrief.docx.title: Cedarline Outdoor pitch debrief
paragraphs: Outcome: lost on 2025-09-30 to a larger agency.
What the client said: the Northbay Kayak case study landed, and the CMO asked for the cost per acquisition figure twice.
What hurt us: the pricing slide came third, and the CFO stopped listening before we showed how we work.
Next time: put pricing after the process slide.

2026-03-brightwell-debrief.docx.title: Brightwell Kombucha pitch debrief
paragraphs: Outcome: won on 2026-03-20, a twelve-month engagement.
What the client said: opening with the Sundew Tea case study before any credentials made it feel like proof, not a sales pitch.
Next time: open with a case study from the prospect's own category, then credentials.

2026-06-quillpay-debrief.docx.title: Quillpay pitch debrief
paragraphs: Outcome: won on 2026-06-24 against two specialist fintech agencies.
What the client said: they chose us because the last slide named the people who would actually work on the account.
Next time: close the pitch on the named team slide, after pricing.
